title: Zero-degree index normalization of localized currying
statement: Let R be a sheaf of commutative rings on a small site with the sheafification hypotheses, and let P,L,I be integer-indexed complexes of R-module sheaves. If a:Hom(P,Hom(L,I))^0 -> Hom(Tot(P tensor L),I)^0 satisfies HomTensorCurryCondition R P L I 0 a [lem-sc-hom-tensor-degreewise], then its localized pure-tensor equation holds with outer index p, output index p+r, and inner projection from Hom(L,I)^p to homObj L^r I^(p+r), using the equalities p+0=p, (p+r)+0=p+r and r+p=p+r. The section, localized site object, and pure tensors are arbitrary, exactly as in HomTensorCurryCondition.

proof.text: First state the same localized equation for arbitrary indices p_prime,t with equalities p+0=p_prime and p+r+0=t. Substitute both equalities and apply the supplied currying condition at p,r,U,s,W,x,y. Instantiate p_prime=p and t=p+r with integer add-zero equalities. Proof irrelevance identifies the index witnesses.

theorem homTensorCurryCondition_zero (P L I : CochainComplex Mod ℤ) :
    letI := SheafOfModules.monoidalCategory R
    ∀ (a : (homComplex (R := R) P (homComplex (R := R) L I)).X 0 ⟶
        (homComplex (R := R)
          (CochainComplex.mapBifunctor P L (curriedTensor Mod)) I).X 0),
      HomTensorCurryCondition R P L I 0 a →
      ∀ (p r : ℤ) (U : Cᵒᵖ)
        (s : (homComplex (R := R) P (homComplex (R := R) L I)).X 0 |>.val.obj U)
        (W : (Over U.unop)ᵒᵖ) (x : (P.X p).val.obj (op W.unop.left))
        (y : (L.X r).val.obj (op W.unop.left)),
      let φ := ((homTensorProjection R
        (CochainComplex.mapBifunctor P L (curriedTensor Mod)) I
        0 (p + r) (p + r) (add_zero _)).val.app U).hom ((a.val.app U).hom s)
      let ψ := ((homTensorProjection R P (homComplex (R := R) L I)
        0 p p (add_zero _)).val.app U).hom s
      let χ := ((homTensorProjection R L I p r (p + r)
        (by omega)).val.app (op W.unop.left)).hom ((ψ.app W).hom x)
      (φ.app W).hom
        (((CochainComplex.ιMapBifunctor P L (curriedTensor Mod)
          p r (p + r) rfl).val.app (op W.unop.left)).hom
          (((homTensorSectionMap R (P.X p) (L.X r)).app (op W.unop.left)).hom
            (x ⊗ₜ[R.obj.obj (op W.unop.left)] y))) =
        (χ.app (op (Over.mk (𝟙 W.unop.left)))).hom y
